title: Optional pgvector and embeddings
description: Add versioned chunk embeddings, pgvector storage/indexes and paper-scoped semantic/hybrid retrieval. Preserve lexical fallback, immutable document citations and token budgets; evaluate retrieval quality against representative questions.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned semantic/hybrid retrieval evaluated without breaking lexical search.
test_cases: Versioned semantic/hybrid retrieval evaluated without breaking lexical search.
verification: Reopened planning. Current retrieval is lexical; no embeddings/vector indexes implemented.
